name: FemCity
source:
You'll play as a boy, who stuck in the city where males are discriminated, while females rule everything in this dark cyberpunk future.
Explore the city, build your relationships with its residents, and reveal its secrets.
Will you able to survive and more of that, manage to escape from the FemCity?

[Source [url=https://kiriowo.itch.io/femcity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一个男孩，被困在男性受到歧视的城市，而女性在这个黑暗的赛博朋克未来统治着一切。
探索这座城市，与居民建立关系，并揭开它的秘密。
你能生存下来，并成功逃离FemCity吗？

[来源 [url=https://kiriowo.itch.io/femcity]itch.io[/url]]
